requirement: Design/PLAYTEST revision: add ducks that fly into the pond; a duck collision while swimming briefly forces the swimmer under and costs time. Shooting a pet or duck already costs 10 seconds.

implementation.behaviour: Fly in from 14-22 m up, settle on open water inside the real lake outline, drift and bob, take off when a rider crowds them, circle out and land elsewhere. Shot ducks are destroyed and are tagged BattleDuck so the existing -10 second animal rule applies.
implementation.swimmer_contact: Within 130 cm of a swimming player: the player is pushed 150 cm under the surface and the run loses 5 seconds with a DUCK! notice, once per duck per 6 seconds. Exact penalty was left as a tuning choice in the design.

regression.note: Shoreline entry, swim, return and remount unaffected by the duck bump.

scope_limits: No duck audio yet; a quack is the obvious next polish.
The duck model is a primitive blockout (body, head, beak, tail) sized small enough to read as a bird at play distance.
The -5 second contact penalty is a tuning choice, not a specified number.
